description:
Because:

- app-store-server-api 1.0.0 ships only an ESM build with an "import" export and drops dist/cjs

This commit:

- bumps app-store-server-api from 0.16.0 to 1.0.0
- adds a yarn patch with a "default" export so CommonJS code can require() it through Node 24 require(esm)
- transforms app-store-server-api and jose 6 in the root, auth-server and admin-server jest configs
- imports from the package root in auth-server specs instead of the removed dist/cjs build
